result.instructions: Tools for Facturis Online, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the invoices issued from 01-11-2026 to 10-11-2026 and their totals."; "Create a client named Example SRL with fiscal code RO12345678 and registration number J40/1234/2020."; "Create an invoice for Example SRL: 10 units of consulting at 100 RON each, 19% VAT, issued today.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Facturis Online data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run facturisonline_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run facturisonline_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run facturisonline_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. facturisonline_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: facturisonline_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products from the Facturis product catalogue (Nomenclatorul de Produse). With no filter it returns all products. To find one product, give both search_field (for example prod_cod for the EAN barcode, or prod_sku) and search_value. API: POST met=Produse act=Get.

search_field.description: Product field to search on, for example prod_cod (EAN) or prod_sku.

tools.name: facturisonline_get_stock
tools.title: Get stock levels
tools.description: Get the stock card for a warehouse (gestiune) at a location (punct de lucru), as Facturis returns it. Both names must match the names set in the account, for example SEDIUL SOCIAL and gestiune principala. API: POST met=Stoc act=Get.

location.description: Location name (punct de lucru) as set in the account, for example SEDIUL SOCIAL.

warehouse.description: Warehouse name (gestiune) as set in the account, for example gestiune principala.

tools.name: facturisonline_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the clients (Clienti) of the company: name, fiscal code, registration number, address, phone and id. The API returns all clients in one reply, so large accounts give a long reply. API: POST met=Clienti act=Get.

tools.name: facturisonline_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List the invoices issued in a date range, as Facturis returns them. Dates use dd-mm-yyyy. API: POST met=Facturi act=Get with date_start and date_stop.

date_start.description: First day of the range, dd-mm-yyyy.

date_stop.description: Last day of the range, dd-mm-yyyy.

tools.name: facturisonline_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Create a client in the Facturis client list. Facturis rejects a client that already exists with the same name, fiscal code and registration number, so a repeat call does not add a second client. The required fields depend on the account settings; Facturis names a missing field in its error. API: POST met=Clienti act=Ins.

tools.name: facturisonline_create_invoice
tools.title: Create an invoice
tools.description: Create a live invoice in the customer's Facturis account. Facturis numbers it (series and number are automatic) and sets it to status Emisa (issued). Each line's totals are computed here from the net unit price, quantity and VAT rate. The call is sent once and is not retried. API: POST met=Facturi act=Ins.

client_fiscal_code.description: Client fiscal code, CUI or CNP.

currency.description: Currency code, for example RON or EUR. Default RON.

vat_rate.description: Default VAT rate for all lines, for example 19%. Default 19%.

location.description: Location name (punct de lucru), as set in the account.

warehouse.description: Warehouse name (gestiune) to issue stock from, as set in the account.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate for this line. Default: the invoice vat_rate.

product_code.description: Product code (EAN) that matches the catalogue, if any.
